# WeCcelerate — Full Content for AI Engines
# This is the extended version of llms.txt with complete service details

> WeCcelerate (וויסלרייט) is Israel's leading Venture Builder providing 360° wrap-around support from idea to successful global startup. Headquartered in Tel Aviv (HaRakevet 58) with offices in Jerusalem, we help early-stage startups access enterprise-grade resources so they can operate like a mature-stage startup from day one. Our strategic partnership with Leumit Health Services (one of Israel's four public health funds, 700,000+ members) provides an exclusive Medical Accelerator track.

---

## Service 1: Business Consulting & Strategy
**URL**: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/business-consulting
**Hebrew**: ייעוץ עסקי ואסטרטגי

Full-service business consulting providing 360° support for founders. Includes:

### Market Research & Consumer Surveys
The first and most significant milestone. Gathering information on markets, competitors and the business environment, including in-depth consumer surveys, to establish marketing ability and differentiation for investors.

### Marketing Plan
A roadmap for achieving goals. Defining customer touchpoints, competitors and the strategy for achieving objectives within a defined timeframe.

### Financial Plan
Forecasting the economic future. Calculating required investments in R&D, marketing and operations to understand breakeven and ROI.

### Investor Pitch Deck
Building a professional investor presentation that tells your story and convinces investors. Including design, financial model and pitch practice.

### Executive Summary (One Pager)
The most important document for investors. Summarizing the problem, solution, market and advantages into a readable document that leads to an investor pitch.

### Investor Preparation & Investment Process Support
Comprehensive preparation for investor meetings, support throughout the investment process, pitch practice and connecting with relevant investors.

### Business Plan
A detailed work plan for proper and efficient planning. Investors and funds examine it to make an investment decision. Includes: capital requirements, pricing, team, market entry and milestones.

---

## Service 2: Physical Product Development
**URL**: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/physical-product
**Hebrew**: פיתוח מוצר פיזי

Recognized as an R&D company by the Israel Innovation Authority. Engineering and design process with two development methods:

### Traditional Method — Development from Scratch
Full development process including target audience analysis, concept development, engineering design, prototyping and mass production.

### Shortcut Method — Global Factory Sourcing
Locating factories and suppliers worldwide for manufacturing and development based on pre-defined requirements. Significantly reducing time and costs.

### Engineering & Design
Utilizing engineers and industrial designers to create blueprints and 3D renderings.

### Prototyping
A crucial stage for real-world testing. Creating the model closest to the final product for feasibility assessment and improvements.

### Mass Production
Planning production lines, product files, manufacturing instructions and preparations for Mass Production.

---

## Service 3: Digital Product Development
**URL**: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/digital-product
**Hebrew**: פיתוח מוצר דיגיטלי

End-to-end technology development for apps, web systems, and SaaS platforms:

### Design & UX/UI
Creating logos, brand books, and full user experience design. Visuals that speak to investors.

### Technical Specification
Precise documentation for developers to prevent mistakes and define budget and timeline.

### Development
Recruiting team (Front, Back, Full Stack), coding under project manager supervision and thorough QA testing.

### Go-to-Market
App Store/Google Play submission, user pilots, and continued feature development.

## Service 4: Marketing, Advertising & PR
**URL**: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/marketing
**Hebrew**: שיווק, פרסום ויח"צ

Full marketing suite for ventures — from strategy to execution:

### Digital Advertising
Managing sponsored campaigns on social networks (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok), Google Ads and additional platforms.

### Public Relations (PR)
Building PR strategy, writing press releases, creating media relationships, and managing the venture's reputation.

### Social Media Marketing
Ongoing management of venture's social media pages — content creation, graphic design, community building and engagement.

### Marketing Strategy
Building a comprehensive marketing plan including target audience mapping, marketing messages, distribution channels and success metrics.

## Service 5: MedTech Accelerator Track (Leumit Partnership)
**URL**: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/medtech-leumit
**Hebrew**: מסלול MedTech (לאומית)
**Premium Track**: Yes

The Leumit WeCcelerate accelerator helps early-stage startups access enterprise-grade resources. We made Leumit's health fund assets accessible at affordable pricing so startups can build their venture correctly from day one.

### End-to-End Support
Supporting entrepreneurs from the idea stage to a working product, with emphasis on early-stage help — expert opinions, regulation and market reviews.

### Expert Physician Opinions
Expert medical opinions to examine the venture's clinical relevance, and professional advice for early stages.

### Full Regulatory Guidance
Help throughout the entire regulatory process — assisting entrepreneurs to navigate the regulatory world simply and correctly, including CE marking and Ministry of Health requirements.

### Leumit Health Services Partnership
WeCcelerate has an exclusive strategic partnership with Leumit Health Services (לאומית שירותי בריאות), one of Israel's four public health funds serving 700,000+ members. Benefits include:
- Anonymized medical data access for R&D
- Clinical pilot programs in Leumit clinics
- Expert physician consultations
- Helsinki Committee guidance
- Regulatory pathway support (CE, Ministry of Health)
- Enhanced credibility with healthcare investors

### Recognition & Memberships
- Recognized as R&D company by Israel Innovation Authority
- Member of Start-Up Nation Central
- Member of IATI (Israel Advanced Technology Industries)
- Top Israeli Business Accelerator

### Track Record
- Portfolio companies raised over $150M collectively
- Network of 200+ specialized investors
- Active across all tech sectors: AI, MedTech, SaaS, IoT, FinTech, FoodTech, RetailTech, Cybersecurity

### Industries Served
WeCcelerate works across all technology sectors including:

## Comprehensive FAQ

**Q: What is WeCcelerate?**
A: WeCcelerate (וויסלרייט) is Israel's leading Venture Builder providing 360° wrap-around support for startups — from idea to successful global venture. We help early-stage startups access enterprise-grade resources: business consulting, product development, marketing, investor preparation and matching, and an exclusive MedTech track in partnership with Leumit Health Services.

**Q: How do I start a startup with WeCcelerate?**
A: Fill out the contact form at weccelerate.co.il/contact. A representative will respond within 48 hours to schedule a free introductory meeting. We support founders from the idea stage through growth companies.

**Q: How much does it cost to develop an MVP?**
A: Costs vary by complexity. Basic mobile app MVP: 50,000-150,000 ILS ($15K-$40K). Web platform: 120,000-400,000 ILS ($30K-$100K). Complex SaaS: 250,000+ ILS ($65K+). Use our free calculator at /tools/mvp-calculator.

**Q: How long does MVP development take?**
A: Typical MVP development takes 6-12 weeks depending on complexity. We use Agile and Lean Startup methodologies to deliver a working product quickly and iterate based on market feedback.

**Q: What does business consulting include?**
A: Market research, competitive analysis, marketing plan, financial plan, executive summary, investor pitch deck, and full business plan — all tailored to investor-grade standards.

**Q: How does WeCcelerate help with marketing?**
A: We provide a full marketing suite: strategy, Google & social media campaigns, PR with Israeli and international media, brand building, and marketing materials design.

**Q: What advantage does the Leumit partnership provide?**
A: Access to anonymized medical data from hundreds of thousands of patients, clinical pilot opportunities, physician consultations, regulatory guidance (CE, Ministry of Health), and enhanced investor credibility.

**Q: Is the program suitable for early-stage entrepreneurs?**
A: Yes, WeCcelerate supports entrepreneurs from the earliest stage — from ideation through specification, development, fundraising, and market launch.

**Q: What is the difference between an accelerator and an incubator?**
A: An incubator focuses on the earliest stages and provides time and space to develop the idea. An accelerator like WeCcelerate is designed for startups with a defined concept and accelerates growth through intensive mentoring, resources, and investor connections.

**Q: What industries does WeCcelerate work with?**
A: All tech sectors: AI, mobile apps, SaaS, IoT, FinTech, EdTech, FoodTech, RetailTech, Cybersecurity, MedTech, physical products, and more.

**Q: How does WeCcelerate help with fundraising?**
A: We prepare professional pitch decks, provide pitch practice, connect founders with our network of 200+ specialized investors (VCs, angels, strategic partners), and support the entire fundraising process from preparation to deal closing.

**Q: Do I need to be a doctor to apply for the MedTech track?**
A: No, you don't need to be a doctor. WeCcelerate looks for teams with a combination of technological and clinical expertise. If you don't have a physician on your team, WeCcelerate can connect you with medical advisors from Leumit's network.
